rental_policy_templates.title: Full-to-Full Fuel Policy
rental_policy_templates.description: Vehicle is delivered with a full tank and must be returned with a full tank. Fuel shortfalls will be charged with a standard service fee.

rental_policy_templates.title: Standard Late Return Policy
rental_policy_templates.description: A 1-hour grace period is granted. Returns beyond 1 hour are charged at PHP 200 per hour.

rental_policy_templates.title: Strict No-Smoking Policy
rental_policy_templates.description: Smoking or vaping inside the vehicle is strictly prohibited. Violations will result in a PHP 2,000 interior detailing charge.

rental_policy_templates.title: Pet Friendly with Carrier
rental_policy_templates.description: Small pets are allowed provided they remain inside an appropriate pet carrier.

rental_policy_templates.title: Flexible Cancellation Policy
rental_policy_templates.description: Free cancellation and full refund of reservation fee if cancelled at least 24 hours before pickup time.

rental_policy_templates.title: Authorized Additional Driver
rental_policy_templates.description: One secondary driver may be authorized at no additional charge with verified license presentation.

verification_requirements.name: Valid Driver's License
verification_requirements.description: Original and non-expired government-issued driver's license.

verification_requirements.name: Government-Issued Secondary ID
verification_requirements.description: Passport, UMID, National ID, or SSS ID.

verification_requirements.name: Reservation Payment Receipt
verification_requirements.description: Proof of reservation fee paid directly to the operator.

verification_requirements.name: Proof of Billing / Address
verification_requirements.description: Utility bill or official document matching renter name.

verification_requirements.name: Refundable Security Deposit
verification_requirements.description: Cash or digital deposit refunded upon safe return.
